ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a low density of high-intensity (white) pixels, yielding an estimated ratio of approximately 98:2.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogenous black field across both lobes, punctuated by small, stochastic high-intensity circular clusters (white dots) concentrated on the left lobe and along the midline near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 80 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth extending approximately 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with medium-amplitude peaks (5-10 pixels) along the left lobe and lower-frequency, shallower undulations on the right lobe lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the superior edges of both lobes, terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white pixel clusters distributed sporadically; approximately 15-20 distinct clusters visible on the left lobe and 5-8 on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, short linear white disruptions visible near the center-left lobe and adjacent to the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular tissue loss (notching) on the superior-lateral edge of the left lobe; focal white scarring at the extreme tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged 'saw-tooth' profile on the trailing edge of the left lobe compared to the smoother profile of the right lobe.
